title: Cities Skylines | Franklin Episode 6: Wooder
premise: The presenter builds Good Hill Water Works, based on Philadelphia’s Fairmount, to argue that useful infrastructure initially privileges the prosperous while eventual health/development benefits and environmental costs complicate the verdict.
coverage: Full machine ASR read; all 28 original contact sheets and 336 original indexed frames visually inspected (0–1230s), plus both supplemental one-frame sheets: frame337 at158.3s and frame338 at458.2s. Total30 sheet images/338 indexed frames inspected. Original sampling: first frame per five-second bin plus scene score >0.30 at480px. Nine native stills inspected at80,158.3,330,360,430,458.2,730,835,1034s. QA denser cue grid additionally inspected for the brief poop emoji and TWICE overlays missed by original sampling; overlay onset/end times are approximate from that grid. Source duration1234.688s. Sparse sampling cannot reveal all brief inserts. Camera descriptions use adjacent sampled images; sound music entries are metadata credits with approximate placement, not independently audited listening. Empty sound arrays mean unannotated, not silence. Full dialogue is source-derived by shared renderer from every timestamped ASR word across chronological panel boundaries, not manually excerpted or human-verified. Historical claims are presenter-attributed. See ../story-sheets/5MrkfLP25Rg.md and ../transcripts/5MrkfLP25Rg.json.
